summary: Authoritative native capability contract for LuminaR Smart Search V9, formalizing supported fields, operators, matching semantics, scope masks, and non-executable boundaries.

GLOBAL.description: Global multi-million book catalog with read-only public access.

unsupported_reasons.year: Global catalog does not index canonical publication year for structured numeric range filtering.
unsupported_reasons.language: Global catalog does not support structured language filtering.
unsupported_reasons.availability: Global catalog items are online-only; physical circulation availability is inapplicable.
unsupported_reasons.formats: Only ONLINE format is indexed in Global catalog.

PUBLIC_TENANT_PATRON.description: Public library catalog with physical and digital circulation for patrons.

PUBLIC_TENANT_STAFF.description: Public library catalog with staff circulation management and metadata access.

PRIVATE_TENANT_PATRON.description: Private institutional library with tenant-isolated collection access.

PRIVATE_TENANT_STAFF.description: Private institutional library with full administrative and circulation access.

title_text.native_behavior: Matches token occurrences in book title; native engine may also cross-match author names.
title_text.boundary_rules: Does not enforce strict title-only substring exclusion without author overlap. If exact title match is mandatory, it must be flagged.

author_text.boundary_rules: Explicit author values must be preserved. Cannot be dropped into generic search text when trailing clauses exist.

subjects.native_behavior: Matches items classified under authoritative Library taxonomy.
subjects.boundary_rules: Only subjects registered in the scope's taxonomy are projected to hard subjects; other topical descriptions project to semantic_text.

rating.boundary_rules: Strict intervals must not invert (min <= max). Relative ratings across entities are UNSUPPORTED.

year.boundary_rules: Unsupported in GLOBAL catalog; supported in institutional tenant catalogs.

formats.boundary_rules: GLOBAL catalog supports only ONLINE. Excluding ONLINE in GLOBAL results in UNSUPPORTED.

sort.native_behavior: Sort by rating_desc, rating_asc, year_desc, year_asc, title_asc.
sort.boundary_rules: Sort specifications must not be converted into author or title tokens.

semantic_text.native_behavior: Free-form topical, thematic, or conceptual query text for hybrid retrieval.
semantic_text.boundary_rules: Must not absorb failed hard constraints. Background framing discourse must be stripped where possible.

page_count.reason: Backend index does not track canonical page counts for structured filtering.
page_count.contract_resolution: Mandatory page-count constraints MUST result in UNSUPPORTED decision. Under-specified clauses (e.g. 'books under pages') where operand is missing are treated as UNSUPPORTED capability requests in V9.

price_and_cost.reason: Catalog is a library lending inventory, not a commercial retail store. No price indexing.
price_and_cost.contract_resolution: Mandatory price constraints MUST result in UNSUPPORTED.

publisher_and_edition.reason: Publisher and edition metadata are not currently indexed as primary search facets.
publisher_and_edition.contract_resolution: Mandatory publisher/edition constraints MUST result in UNSUPPORTED.

title_only_substring_search.reason: Native title_text query expansion matches both title and creator/author tokens. Strict title-only substring exclusion is not enforceable by native backend.
examples: title containing 'test' but author does not match 'test'
title_only_substring_search.contract_resolution: Inherited legacy test 'test_quoted_filter_words_owned_by_literal_title' expects executable title-only substring behavior. In V9, this is formally recognized as an unsupported native capability boundary. V9 refuses silent false execution and maintains UNSUPPORTED safety.

cross_book_relative_comparisons.reason: Single query projection cannot perform multi-pass entity lookups (e.g. resolve Book A rating, then filter books with higher rating).
examples: books with higher rating than Dune

missing_author.condition: Explicit 'by:' prefix present without author operand.
missing_author.clarification_prompt: Please specify the author name you are searching for.

unresolved_disjunction.condition: Query specifies 'either X or Y' across distinct entities/fields.
unresolved_disjunction.clarification_prompt: Please select which of the options you would like to search for.

ambiguous_comma_scope.condition: Comma-separated list following exclusion or negation where scope is ambiguous.
ambiguous_comma_scope.clarification_prompt: Please clarify whether the exclusion applies to multiple subjects or a subject and a format.
